title: Eco-friendly synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles using Delonix elata extract with enhanced antibacterial activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39305-39313
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05208D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jayashree Nanthakumar, Yasotha Palanisamy, Sivasubramanian Palanisamy, Manickaraj Karuppusamy, Ramkumar Raja, Mohamed Abbas, Aravindhan Alagarsamy, Md Zillur Rahman
ZnO nanoparticles synthesized using Delonix elata leaf extract showed strong antibacterial activity against E. coli but not S. aureus, with a stable wurtzite structure (∼30 nm) and an optical band gap of 2.7 eV.
